snippet.title: Hyperbeat - Official Multiplayer Update Launch Trailer
snippet.description: Get a look at the Multiplayer Update Launch Trailer for Hyperbeat, a stylized rhythm action game developed by Alice Bottino and Chancellor Wallin. Players will join forces with the latest update to play with up to 250 other players in private or public lobbies. Compete on the leaderboards with five new songs with the Hyperbeat Multiplayer Update, available now for PC (Steam).
